metaData.title: 5 Practical Agent Office Workflows Using Claude Code + Feishu.
metaData.oneSentenceSummary: This article shares 5 practical Agent office automation cases based on Claude Code and Feishu CLI, covering meeting knowledge base building, work retrospectives, reconciliation processes, collaborative whiteboards, and automated expense reimbursement.
metaData.summary: Based on real practices from the author's company (a team of about 30 people), this article details how to leverage Feishu CLI's open capabilities to enable Agents like Claude Code to directly control Feishu for office automation. Key cases include: 1) Automatically fetching meeting notes data for recurring meetings (topic selection meetings, training sessions) to build a cross-session knowledge base; 2) Agents pulling data in parallel from Feishu private messages, group chats, meetings, meeting notes, schedules, tasks, emails, documents, and OKRs to automatically generate personal quarterly work retrospective reports; 3) Automating the reconciliation process, where an Agent bot pulls data from multi-dimensional tables, interacts with bloggers in a group, and automatically routes tasks to business or finance teams based on feedback; 4) Using Feishu's whiteboard capabilities, Agents directly generate architecture diagrams, flowcharts, and even PPTs that can be collaboratively edited by the entire team; 5) Agents automatically extracting invoices from Feishu email, filling in and submitting expense reports according to the standard operating procedure (SOP), with the approval end also handled by an Agent after verifying the information. The article emphasizes that Feishu CLI now covers 15 business domains and 114 capabilities, and the deep integration of Agents with Feishu is reshaping team collaboration.

mainPoints.point: Feishu CLI has opened up 114 capabilities, enabling Agents to directly control Feishu for office automation.
mainPoints.explanation: Feishu CLI covers 15 business domains, allowing Agents to call its capabilities to directly operate Feishu documents, spreadsheets, messages, meetings, approvals, etc., without manual interface interaction.

mainPoints.point: Agents can automatically fetch meeting notes data to build a cross-session knowledge base.
mainPoints.explanation: For recurring meetings like weekly syncs and training sessions, Agents can pull historical meeting notes, automatically analyze meeting agendas, topic conversion rates, decision-making mechanisms, etc., and generate structured knowledge documents.

mainPoints.point: Agents can pull data from all Feishu dimensions in parallel to automatically generate personal work retrospective reports.
mainPoints.explanation: Agents can simultaneously extract data from private messages, group chats, meetings, meeting notes, schedules, tasks, emails, documents, and OKRs to generate a quarterly report that includes time allocation, collaboration details, project outputs, and actionable insights.

mainPoints.point: Agent bots can replace manual work for repetitive processes like reconciliation and expense reimbursement.
mainPoints.explanation: Reconciliation and expense reimbursement processes are encapsulated as Agent bots, which automatically query tables, interact, and route tasks, achieving end-to-end automation from data retrieval to approval completion.

mainPoints.point: Collaborative whiteboards generated by Agents are more practical than static HTML or images.
mainPoints.explanation: Agents directly generate native Feishu whiteboards that team members can drag, edit, and add nodes to, enabling true real-time collaboration, suitable for architecture diagrams, flowcharts, PPTs, and more.

keyQuotes: Now, when you use something like Claude Code to control Feishu, if your requirements aren't too extreme or geeky, you can do almost everything.
Because Feishu has a wealth of real context, the documents it generates are actually usable, not just filler reports that pad word counts.
Using Agents to control Feishu for multi-faceted efficiency and collaboration might be a key factor in the evolution of many organizations today.
The day Feishu opens up all its capabilities and the entire platform is almost fully CLI-ized, I think our way of working and collaborating will enter a whole new era.
